result.subject: Quick check on sanctions screening review
result.body:
Hi CRO,

I hope you’re well. I wanted to touch base on the external review of the sanctions screening model, which was due on October 6. As we’re 35 days past the target, could you share a brief status update? If a new timeline is needed, a realistic completion date would be helpful so I can keep the CEO informed before the Board meets on November 26. Please let me know if there’s anything I can do to help unblock the work.

Thanks,
Business Operations
